operations.description: GDPR personal-data counters lookup keyed by a single email address supplied by the caller; not a list-shaped/discoverable resource and has no natural incremental or full-refresh catalog semantics
operations.approval: not implemented: the direct-read executor has no non-redacting output policy for this provider operation

operations.description: irreversibly deletes all survey responses, respondent records, and connected-service (Insights Hub) data for the given email address; a GDPR-erasure action, never a reverse-ETL-safe mutation
operations.approval: not implemented: the REST write executor lacks a reviewed operation-specific body, risk, approval, and execution contract

operations.description: no endpoint exists to enumerate respondent_uuid values across a workspace; a lone attributes-by-id GET with no discovery path is not a syncable stream without a respondent_uuid already in hand from an external source (e.g. one embedded in a responses-stream record)
operations.approval: not implemented: the direct-read executor has no non-redacting output policy for this provider operation

operations.description: same respondent_uuid discovery gap as the attributes endpoint above; also a duplicate record shape of the survey-scoped responses stream, which already yields every response for every discoverable survey
operations.approval: not implemented: the direct-read executor has no non-redacting output policy for this provider operation

operations.approval: not implemented: the direct-read executor has no non-redacting output policy for this provider operation
